if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/stm32cubemx/CMakeLists.txt")
    add_subdirectory(cmake/stm32cubemx)
endif()

# Locate Startup and Linker Script
file(GLOB STARTUP_FILES RELATIVE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} startup_*.s Core/Src/startup_*.s)
file(GLOB LINKER_FILES RELATIVE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} *_FLASH.ld *.ld)

set(STARTUP_FILE_PATH "")
if(STARTUP_FILES)
    list(GET STARTUP_FILES 0 STARTUP_FILE)
    set(STARTUP_FILE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${STARTUP_FILE}")
else()
    file(GLOB FALLBACK_STARTUP "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../g474_nucleo/startup_*.s")
    if(FALLBACK_STARTUP)
        list(GET FALLBACK_STARTUP 0 STARTUP_FILE_PATH)
    endif()
endif()

set(LINKER_SCRIPT_PATH "")
if(LINKER_FILES)
    list(GET LINKER_FILES 0 LINKER_SCRIPT)
    set(LINKER_SCRIPT_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${LINKER_SCRIPT}")
else()
    file(GLOB FALLBACK_LINKER "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../g474_nucleo/*_FLASH.ld")
    if(FALLBACK_LINKER)
        list(GET FALLBACK_LINKER 0 LINKER_SCRIPT_PATH)
    endif()
endif()

# Developer Sandbox / Single-File Direct Execution Target
if(NOT DEFINED SANDBOX_FILE OR SANDBOX_FILE STREQUAL "" OR NOT EXISTS "${SANDBOX_FILE}")
    set(SANDBOX_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../sandbox/sandbox.c")
endif()
get_filename_component(SANDBOX_FILE_ABS "${SANDBOX_FILE}" ABSOLUTE)
get_filename_component(SANDBOX_DIR "${SANDBOX_FILE_ABS}" DIRECTORY)

# Collect Board Core Sources
set(BOARD_SRCS "")
if(STARTUP_FILE_PATH AND EXISTS "${STARTUP_FILE_PATH}")
    list(APPEND BOARD_SRCS "${STARTUP_FILE_PATH}")
endif()

file(GLOB LOCAL_CORE_SRCS RELATIVE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    Core/Src/main.c
    Core/Src/syscalls.c
    Core/Src/sysmem.c
    Core/Src/*_it.c
    Core/Src/*_hal_msp.c
)
if(LOCAL_CORE_SRCS)
    foreach(SRC ${LOCAL_CORE_SRCS})
        list(APPEND BOARD_SRCS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${SRC}")
    endforeach()
else()
    file(GLOB FALLBACK_CORE_SRCS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../g474_nucleo/Core/Src/main.c"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../g474_nucleo/Core/Src/syscalls.c"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../g474_nucleo/Core/Src/sysmem.c"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../g474_nucleo/Core/Src/*_it.c"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../g474_nucleo/Core/Src/*_hal_msp.c"
    )
    list(APPEND BOARD_SRCS ${FALLBACK_CORE_SRCS})
endif()

# Helper function to configure board executables
function(add_board_target_executable TARGET_NAME)
    add_executable(${TARGET_NAME}
        ${BOARD_SRCS}
        ${ARGN}
    )
    target_include_directories(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/Inc
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../g474_nucleo/Core/Inc
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../shared/include
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../drivers/include
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../services/include
    )
    target_compile_options(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE
        -mcpu=cortex-m4 -mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard -mthumb
    )
    target_link_libraries(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE
        -Wl,--start-group
        rov_services
        rov_drivers
        rov_shared
        m
    )
    if(TARGET stm32cubemx_zz_can)
        target_link_libraries(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE stm32cubemx_zz_can)
    elseif(TARGET stm32cubemx)
        target_link_libraries(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE stm32cubemx)
    elseif(TARGET g474_platform)
        target_link_libraries(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE g474_platform)
    endif()
    target_link_libraries(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE
        -Wl,--end-group
    )
    set(LINK_FLAGS
        -mcpu=cortex-m4 -mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard -mthumb
        -Wl,-Map=${TARGET_NAME}.map
        -Wl,--gc-sections
        -u _printf_float
    )
    if(LINKER_SCRIPT_PATH AND EXISTS "${LINKER_SCRIPT_PATH}")
        list(APPEND LINK_FLAGS -T "${LINKER_SCRIPT_PATH}")
    endif()
    target_link_options(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE
        ${LINK_FLAGS}
    )
endfunction()

# 1. Developer Sandbox Target: zz_can_sandbox.elf
add_board_target_executable(zz_can_sandbox.elf
    "${SANDBOX_FILE_ABS}"
)
target_include_directories(zz_can_sandbox.elf PRIVATE
    "${SANDBOX_DIR}"
)

# 2. Node Executables (if node sources exist)
foreach(NODE node1_pi_shield node2_control_board node3_power_slab)
    set(NODE_APP "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../nodes/${NODE}/Core/Src/app.c")
    if(EXISTS "${NODE_APP}")
        add_board_target_executable(zz_can_${NODE}.elf
            "${NODE_APP}"
        )
        target_include_directories(zz_can_${NODE}.elf PRIVATE
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../nodes/${NODE}/Core/Inc"
        )
        if(NOT "zz" STREQUAL "zz_can")
            if(NOT TARGET zz_${NODE}.elf)
                add_custom_target(zz_${NODE}.elf DEPENDS zz_can_${NODE}.elf)
            endif()
        endif()

        # Add alias without numeric node prefix (e.g. pi_shield, control_board, power_slab)
        string(REGEX REPLACE "^node[0-9]_" "" NODE_SHORT "${NODE}")
        if(NOT "${NODE_SHORT}" STREQUAL "${NODE}")
            if(NOT TARGET zz_can_${NODE_SHORT}.elf)
                add_custom_target(zz_can_${NODE_SHORT}.elf DEPENDS zz_can_${NODE}.elf)
            endif()
            if(NOT "zz" STREQUAL "zz_can")
                if(NOT TARGET zz_${NODE_SHORT}.elf)
                    add_custom_target(zz_${NODE_SHORT}.elf DEPENDS zz_can_${NODE}.elf)
                endif()
            endif()
        endif()
    endif()
endforeach()

# 3. Short name aliases and mirroring
if(NOT "zz" STREQUAL "zz_can")
    if(NOT TARGET zz_sandbox.elf)
        add_custom_target(zz_sandbox.elf DEPENDS zz_can_sandbox.elf)
    endif()
    add_custom_command(TARGET zz_can_sandbox.elf POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            "$<TARGET_FILE:zz_can_sandbox.elf>"
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/zz_sandbox.elf"
    )
endif()
